scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Salt dissolving basics
experiments.focus: Show a classic soluble salt forming a clear solution.
student_observations: The solid becomes smaller as it dissolves.
A solution is not the same as a solid mix.
experiments.teacher_note: Use as a baseline example for solution formation.

experiments.title: Ethanol evaporation idea
experiments.focus: Compare how different liquids can behave differently in the model.
student_observations: The liquid can seem to disappear over time in the model.
Some liquids change faster than others.
Volatility is a property of matter.
experiments.teacher_note: Keep the discussion conceptual and avoid any real heating steps.

experiments.title: Vinegar and salt contrast
experiments.focus: Compare a weak acid liquid with a neutral salt in water.
student_observations: The liquids have different roles in the model.
The salt dissolves while the vinegar stays a liquid.
Acids and salts are different classes of substances.
experiments.teacher_note: Use this as a classification activity.

experiments.title: Vinegar and bicarbonate concept
experiments.focus: Show a safe classroom gas-release concept through a weak acid and bicarbonate model.
student_observations: Gas formation is a visible sign of chemical change.
experiments.teacher_note: Concept only; the app should present this at a classroom-safe level.
